name: Team Store Stock Balance
query:
SELECT
  st.name AS "Team:Link/Service Team:160",
  b.item_code AS "Item:Link/Item:200",
  b.actual_qty AS "Qty:Float:100",
  i.stock_uom AS "UOM:Link/UOM:90",
  b.valuation_rate AS "Valuation Rate:Currency:130",
  (b.actual_qty * b.valuation_rate) AS "Value:Currency:140"
FROM `tabBin` b
JOIN `tabItem` i ON i.name = b.item_code
JOIN `tabService Team` st ON st.team_warehouse = b.warehouse
WHERE b.actual_qty != 0
  AND (%(service_team)s = '' OR st.name = %(service_team)s)
  AND (%(item_group)s = '' OR i.item_group = %(item_group)s)
ORDER BY st.name, b.item_code
